profile.headline: Software Engineer at SEAKR Engineering LLC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer working with C++, Python, and Lua developing code to test the hardware functionality of flight equipment.

Key role in communication and approving documentation for internal and external uses.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Recurring Product Engineer that tested aerospace hardware. Use procedures to test hardware and made changes to procedures for better performance. When issues occurred would partner with the responsible engineer of the suspect component and work to resolve any issues. Gain experience in various field of power, design, and software.
positions.insights: Software Development, Technical Support and +4 skills

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Recurring Product Engineer, part time while finishing degree.
positions.insights: Software Development, Technical Support and +4 skills

positions.title: Night Stocker
positions.locationName: Lone Tree, Colorado, United States · On-site
positions.description: In charge of organizing and restocking multiple aisles after close. Leave with merchandise in a presentable state and help others when needed. Often used in other departments because of experience and leadership.

positions.title: Major Sales Supervisor
positions.description: While working in this position I responsible for creating a plan oh the layout for tvs, laptops, security systems, and various other electronic devices. I also was responsible of keeping track of inventory of over 100 products and had to schedule proper coverage for the department while making time for training for my employees. in my first four months over this department I produced two employee of the months out of 300+ employees.

positions.title: Front End Supervisor
positions.description: I quickly became the strongest supervisor and after helped train 20+ future supervisors and 5 future managers. I was marked ready to be a manager, but decided not to pursue to focus on school. I had to maintain and regulate scheduling and payroll while managing 100+ employees and monitoring their meal periods and breaks according to the flow of business. I watched over the front end registers, but every other department was my responsibility too. I had to make sure they didn't need any help and if they did finding the right employee for the job.
